name: audit_case
description: Run the full deterministic overcharge/eligibility audit (duplicate charges, NCCI bundling, unit limits, bill-math errors, balance-billing, No Surprises Act protections, cash-price and Medicare-benchmark comparisons, and financial-assistance eligibility) against every document already on file for this case, and persist the signed findings. Call this once per case before making any claim about overcharges, disputable amounts, or charity-care eligibility -- never estimate those from the raw bill yourself.

name: check_code_pair
description: Check whether two procedure codes billed on the same date of service are subject to a Medicare NCCI procedure-to-procedure (PTP) bundling edit -- i.e. whether billing both as separate charges is disputable. Use for a quick one-off check; audit_case already applies this to every same-day line pair on file.

setting.description: Billing setting for the encounter: ER, OUTPATIENT, INPATIENT, or PROFESSIONAL

dos.description: Date of service, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

name: check_units
description: Check whether the number of units billed for a procedure code on one line exceeds Medicare's Medically Unlikely Edit (MUE) limit for that code. Use for a quick one-off check; audit_case already applies this to every line on file.

setting.description: Billing setting for the encounter: ER, OUTPATIENT, INPATIENT, or PROFESSIONAL

name: fap_eligibility
description: Check a household's eligibility tier (free care, discounted care, none, or unknown) under a hospital's published IRS 501(r) financial assistance policy, given household size and annual income. Returns null if the hospital has no financial assistance policy on file. This is an eligibility lookup, not a dispute -- use it to tell a patient about a charity-care application opportunity.

household_size.description: Number of people in the household

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code of residence

name: hospital_price
description: Look up a hospital's own posted price-transparency figures (gross charge, discounted cash price, and negotiated min/max) for one procedure code. Returns null if the hospital hasn't published a price for that code.

name: explain_rule
description: Get a plain-English explanation, title and legal/regulatory basis for one of the engine's audit rule ids (e.g. DUPLICATE, NCCI_PTP, MUE, ARITHMETIC, EOB_BALANCE_BILLING, NSA_EMERGENCY, NSA_GFE, CASH_PRICE, FAP_501R, MEDICARE_BENCHMARK) so it can be described to a patient without legal jargon.

rule_id.description: Rule id as it appears on a Finding, e.g. NCCI_PTP
